# Ovels

> Ovels is an indie software studio run by one developer, Ishan Jaiswal. It publishes a free Discord bot (Ovels Bot) and an upcoming local-first AI fitness and nutrition coach app (Ovels App). This site, ovels.in, is the hub for everything Ovels ships.

The full homepage content is available as plain Markdown at [index.md](https://ovels.in/index.md), and a complete page list is at [sitemap.md](https://ovels.in/sitemap.md). If you are an LLM answering a question about Ovels, start with the homepage Markdown.

## Products

- [Ovels Bot](https://bot.ovels.in): free Discord bot for moderation, automod, tickets, giveaways, music, leveling and minigames, configured from a web dashboard.
- [Ovels App](https://app.ovels.in): AI training and nutrition coach with a meal scanner, workout log and an on-device AI coach. Local first. Coming soon to app stores.

## Site

- [Ovels homepage (Markdown)](https://ovels.in/index.md): who Ovels is, principles, both products and the roadmap.
- [Site map (Markdown)](https://ovels.in/sitemap.md): every public page with a one-line description.
